notes.title: 1.16.3: Added Config File for Binding Movement Keys.
notes.content:
You can now customize your movement keys using a configuration file added to your save game folder.
[list]
[*][b]KeyBindings.config[/b] contains the 6 input movements with the associated key.
[*][b]KeyBindingsReference.config[/b] contains the list of compatible key bindings you can use for your movement.
[*][b]NOTE:[/b] Ensure that you do not share the same keys between movement and other actions (for example, opening the inventory and moving forward).
[/list]

notes.title: Exciting News: Announcing Ruzar - The Dark Stones!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

I am thrilled to announce the upcoming release of Ruzar - The Dark Stones, the sequel to Ruzar - The Life Stone!

In this new chapter, you will venture beyond the Mountain of Ruz, exploring new environments and uncovering the secrets of the Dark Stones. With enhanced gameplay features and a brand new narrative, your journey through treacherous dungeons and mysterious landscapes will test your determination and cunning at every turn.

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Advanced Character Customization: Shape your adventurer's destiny with an expanded character creation menu, allowing for richer personalization and strategic development.
[*] Dynamic Party System: Control up to four characters, switching between them to utilize their unique skills and spells, and adapt your party to the challenges ahead.
[*] Advanced Binding Stones: Use these mystical stones to quickly travel across the vast interconnected world, ensuring you're always at the heart of the action.
[*] Underground Network: Access your stored resources through a comprehensive underground network, making it easier to manage your treasures and crafting materials.
[*] Innovative Crafting System: Interact with crafting stations scattered throughout the world, where you can create items and equipment to aid you in your quest.
[*] Thrilling Plot: Dive into a brand-new storyline filled with intrigue and danger.
[*] Revamped Spells and Skills System: Master a new range of spells and skills, each with unique effects and strategies to enhance your gameplay experience.
[/list]

Ruzar - The Dark Stones offers a fresh take on the classic dungeon crawler, where survival depends on character progression, strategic party management, and mastering both combat and crafting. Are you ready to face the darkness and uncover the power behind the Dark Stones?

You can check out the store page here [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/778440/Ruzar__Les_Pierres_des_Tnbres/]Ruzar - The Dark Stones[/url]

notes.title: Version 1.13 (+Spanish)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

This new patch introduces a new language: Spanish.
There are also two fixes for the game.
[list]
[*] There was a bug that was preventing you from saving your game if you used to exit the game while in a challenge (not in the DLC).
[*] We've never seen that before, but a user was able to report a bug where all the creatures in the level were spawned at an infinite position causing all creatures to spawn outside of the world. We now make sure that if that happens, the creatures are respawned at their default position.
[/list]

Thanks for reporting any new issue you can find.

notes.title: Update 1.10 Requirement
notes.content:
Please note that with the new update, you will need to replace the equipped items on your character(s). With the addition of the new slot for the ranged attack, some items have been moved and you will have to remove and add them back so they work correctly.

One user had his difficulty level and binding keys reset. 
EDIT: We just fix that specific issue. Some user might encounter a reset in the key bindings and the language (if they synced prior to this announcement). We apologize for it. New user won't be affected by the issue.
If you encounter any issue regarding the new update, please let us know through email at: support a-t hammerglassstudio dot com with a short explanation of the issue.

Thanks and sorry for the issue.

notes.title: Version 1.10
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[h1]Here is a new update:[/h1]
[list]
[*] We added a new slot for the ranged weapons. Many of you requested the ability to have a way to quickly equip a bow / crossbow during combat. Now you can equip a bow / crossbow and another weapon. You will still need to switch between all three of them (default is "x") in order to select the one you want to use (weapon1, weapon2, magic).
[*] The creature speed has been increased only in hard and insane difficulty. Some of you thought the game was too easy. So now all creatures in these two modes are faster (insane is a little bit faster than hard).
[*] Reloading the game upon death doesn't penalize your amount of hp anymore. Now that the game reloads automatically, there is no need to have the malus on your HP.
[*] You can now double click on the spells to equip / unequip them. No need to click on the memorize / remove button if you don't want to.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy this new version!

notes.title: Version 1.09
notes.content:
Hi and Happy New Year :)

[h1]Here is a new update with some fixes and changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Skill Precision for the Ranger is now changed. Now the skill reduces the armor of the creature when you use ranged weapons.
[*] German version is now available. PLEASE, if you see any issue, let us know.
[*] The Save games from the old versions (EA) are not copied over the new path now. Saved games in the Cloud from EA were causing issue with some EA users.
[*] Save Games now have the correct spent time value in the save game info.
[*] Gold loot has been reduced.
[*] Fixed some minor streaming issues.
[*] Fixed some glitches in different levels.
[*] The Quest Complete message is now working if you have items in your storage.
[*] The Keskan Queen is now fixed. Sometimes the creature was unspawned if you were not looking for her right after talking to the soul.
[*] Level 45 armors are now counted for the Heavy Armor Kit achievement.
[*] Sometimes the creature could die twice in a row. This is now fixed.
[*] Fixed an audio issue with male and female character sound when switching the game from male to female and vice versa.
[*] One Sanctuary Level 2 trap game play has changed. There was a potential blocker.
[*] Poison secondary effect is now displayed properly if you have multiple poison effects playing.
[*] Mana staff now regenerates mana points. Depending of the strength of the staff, the regeneration is faster. The Transfuge spells cost have been increased.
[*] Fixed an issue with being able to click through the UI when opening the inventory with the character picture.
[*] Fixed loot behavior when your inventory is almost full.
[*] Fixed an issue where you couldn't damage a creature on top of a pit in melee.
[*] Fixed some typos.
[*] Fixed map and inventory issue when you had the UI opened and loading another level.
[*] Fixed a movement issue when you were closing the map or the inventory while moving.
[*] Updated the bestiary for the Roaming Skeletons quest.
[/list]

Thanks.

notes.title: Version 1.05
notes.content:
[h1]A new Update![/h1]

Here is a new version that will help you avoid two blockers (the key - in a rare situation in the Temple lvl 3 and another situation when falling in another section of the Cave Lvl 1)

Here is the list of fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*] The quest for the sample is now fixed.
[*] The Solid key issue has been fixed. If you managed to reach the Temple lvl3 without collecting all loots, you might have two bags in some of the sections. We updated the loot, but if you saved a previous version, then the loot will be duplicated (safer than deleting your game). If you managed to already open the door (to reach the puzzle with the 4 levers), this fix is not for you.
[*] In the Caves Lvl1, you could be stuck if you fall in the traps in one of the Mage section. This has been fixed (teleport + falling outside of the world).
[*] Now when you cast the spell Return Home, you can cast other spells when you reload your level (all spells were disabled).
[*] Now the spell Return Home is available at the level 10.
[*] The spell Show Secret is now available at the level 15.
[*] Stone arrow spell cool down has been lowered.
[*] Changed spell description for the lightning spells. 
[*] Added a duration description for a few spells.
[*] Now the spells that you can use to buff your equipement have the proper timing (the duration in the spell panel is also correct now).
[*] The regeneration spells have been tweaked.
[*] There was an issue with the potions in the inventory (half of the UI was disappearing). This is now fixed.
[*] We added the poison potions in the store (there was only the healing and the mana potion).
[*] Fixed the prices for the potions in the merchant store.
[*] The "+" icon to let you know you have points to spend in your character is now removed when you press "esc" and have no more points to spend.
[*] Damages are now rounded correctly (no more decimal).
[*] We added a dark stone in the Cave lvl1. The respawn is fast and you need to destroy the stone if you don't want to see enemies again :)
[*] Now in NG+, the player receives more XP than before.
[*] In Insane, the difficulty has been lowered, but the damages done by the creature are still high.
[*] Some skeletons had a block ability, it has been removed as they don't have shields.
[*] The floating stones don't block anymore.
[*] The bestiary requirements to unlock the creatures have been lowered.
[/list]

This is it for now, but we still have more items on our list and the map issue hasn't been resolved yet.

We hope you like the new fixes and changes.

Have a good week-end :)

notes.title: Dev Update #3
notes.content:
[h1]Here is another dev update:[/h1]

We have been working on few things we hope you'll enjoy. A beta version will be released soon for you to help us identify major bugs and give use more time before we publish this version to everyone. Major elements (like the save game) have been changed and we want to make sure it doesn't break the game.

So, here are the details:

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The save games have been modified. You know have three save games available. 
[*] We changed the way the saves actually work. You will need to save your game (like most of the other games) as you progress, otherwise your game progression will be lost. The game won't save your progress when you quit the game or when you go back to the main menu as it used to do it before.
[*] Level of difficulty has been tweaked. You now get more xp when you select a higher difficulty (debatable?). The creatures are doing more damages and have more resistances and when you respawn (after dying), your health is lower.
[*] Three more levels have been added to the game (Mine Theme) with a new gameplay element.
[*] A new creature has been added to the mines level.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixes some streaming issues in the different levels
[*] Some potions didn't have the correct setup (health and mana were mixed up)
[*] A minor update on the audio part. A lot of sounds were playing even if the volume was set to zero. Now the audio clips are disabled if you are far away.
[*] Some collisions have been updated for the decorations in the levels.
[*] The map now has the correct information (some items were not flagged correctly)
[*] The loot interaction distance has been increased to support situation when the loot is almost out of screen.
[*] All the spell texts have been shorten to support both french and english version ("Spell Book of" has been removed).
[*] Fixed issues with the buy and sell audio sound in specific situations.
[*] A bug with the alcoves have been fixed (for the red orbs).
[/list]

Thanks!

It is only available to the people who actually asked to participate to the beta version. If there is no new bugs introduced we will move it for everyone in the next few days.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new dungeons (x3).
[*] Added new camera to be able to look around.
[*] Added one new creature.
[*] Added a text to inform that a chest is empty.
[*] Added a text in the alcove when it can receive an item.
[*] Added a text to hint the player in the Temple 1 Level 4.
[*] Added keys for chest and doors with gold lock.
[*] Added more secrets in the Temple levels.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed wasp wings. They are now visible from every sides.
[*] Fixed tooltip issues when moving outside of the screen in the smallest resolution.
[*] Fixed some streaming issues in the different levels.
[*] Fixed Blending Animation Glitch for the Turn and the Walk.
[*] Fixed Windows detection for some gameplay depending of the resolution.
[*] Fixed french typo issues (thanks to Conan!). 
[*] Fixed Binding Stone Teleport issue in a specific case.
[*] Fixed Bookshelf UVs and Shape.
[*] Fixed Lightning spell playing the effect twice.
[/list]

Thanks for all the feedback and comments so far!

notes.title: Alpha v0.23 (Beta)
notes.content:
A new version has been pushed on a beta branch.
It is only available to the people who actually asked to participate to the beta version. If there is no new bugs introduced we will move it for everyone.

[h1]Here are the new updates / fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tab can be used to show / hide the map.
[*] The flail for the skeleton has now effects when hitting the ground
[*] Save Game - We are working to have multiple save game available to support multiple character creation. The first step was to create the different slots for the save game (x3). The default save game is now moved to the 1st slot. We will need to add in the main menu an option to be able to select which save you want to use for your current game.
[*] Note System - You do not need to confirm you want to add a note anymore (the message has been removed). Also, the description for the note can be empty now. We only require you to add a name for the note.
[*] A torch has been added in the Mountain Level 3 to help identify an area for the bone fire. Some people missed it.
[*] Quests have been improved and updated to support multiple quests from a single character (The merchant for example). Quests will arrive in the next major update.
[*] Fixed: The check mark in the french version for the Quest was hidden when completed. 
[*] Fixed: Some walls didn't have a proper collision in the Temple levels.
[*] Fixed: An item was accessible when it was not supposed to be. This is now resolved.
[*] Fixed: A player detection in one of the puzzle in the Temple was not correct. 
[*] Fixed: Some items name in the store were showing up outside of the tooltip area.
[/list]

Thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: Dev Update #1
notes.content:
We decided that we should post more dev update to inform you about the progress of the game. We want to make sure we give as much visibility as possible.

[h1]So for the first update, here is what we have been working on:[/h1]
[b]Improvement:[/b]
[list]
[*]Spells have been tweaked to be more accessible. Casting time is slower, damage is lower, mana cost is lower.
[*]Fire Arrow spell has been added as the default spell when you start the game.
[*]The temple level is almost completed. We still need to add some assets in the levels to add more variety.
[*]You can now bind your keys for your potions, spells and arrows/bolts. You need to setup your shortcuts in the main menu (options).
[*]Added a custom cursor for the secret buttons.
[*]All creatures speed have been increased.
[*]The note system has been improved. Now you can add a description to your note and you also have a tooltip available once the note is created.
[*]A note has been added near the first corpse where is the first bonefire. It hints to the bonefire and his effects. 
[*]To avoid confusion, a lot of alcoves have been removed if they don't have any loot.
[*]We also introduce a new enemy: a flying creature. Some screenshots will be available soon.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]The top section of the mini map was not working correctly with the higher resolutions. It has now been fixed.
[*]There was a small bug in the health/mana bar that was not refreshed correctly.
[*]Now the loot close to a bonefire will have the correct cursor icon.
[/list]

The next version should come very soon, right now we want to make sure we don't introduce new bugs :)

Thanks.

notes.title: Alpha v0.11
notes.content:
[h1]Here is the first update list of fixes for the game:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Health back on death has been raised by 20%.
[*]Fixed alcove with special loot and doors.
[*]Loot that was not disappearing has been fixed (might need to delete the save game).
[*]Added arrow keys to move the character.
[*]Vsync is on by default for High and Very Quality (the game caps at 60fps).
[*]Numbers have been added on top of the Health, Mana and Xp bars.
[*]A fix has been added in case the player spawns outside of the world (there has been a case with a crash causing the player to respawn outside of the world). If that happens, the player now restarts at the beginning of the level.
[*]Fixed movements and cameras issues when pressing multiple keys at the same time.
[*]Fixed French title in the Binding stone menu.
[/list]
